question: centre with the largest drop in attendance percentage between 2023 and 2024 (average of monthly rates, drop in percentage points, positive)
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

centre with the largest drop in attendance percentage between 2023 and 2024 (average of monthly rates, drop in percentage points, positive)
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH combined_2023 AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre",
        "Month",
        "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment,
        "Avg Daily Present" AS average_attendance
    FROM "attendance_2023"
    WHERE "Centre" IN ('Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi', 'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi', 'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi')
    AND "Month" IN ('April', 'August', 'December', 'February', 'January', 'July', 'June', 'March', 'May', 'November', 'October', 'September')
),

combined_2024 AS (
    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS "Centre",
        "month" AS "Month",
        "enrolment",
        "average_attendance"
    FROM "attendance_2024"
    WHERE "centre_name" IN ('Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi', 'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi', 'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi')
    AND "month" IN ('April', 'August', 'December', 'February', 'January', 'July', 'June', 'March', 'May', 'November', 'October', 'September')
),

attendance_rates_2023 AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre",
        "Month",
        (average_attendance / NULLIF(enrolment, 0)) * 100 AS attendance_percentage
    FROM combined_2023
),

attendance_rates_2024 AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre",
        "Month",
        (average_attendance / NULLIF(enrolment, 0)) * 100 AS attendance_percentage
    FROM combined_2024
),

monthly_drops AS (
    SELECT
        a."Centre",
        a."Month",
        a.attendance_percentage AS "2023 Attendance %",
        b.attendance_percentage AS "2024 Attendance %",
        (a.attendance_percentage - b.attendance_percentage) AS "Drop in Percentage Points"
    FROM attendance_rates_2023 a
    JOIN attendance_rates_2024 b ON a."Centre" = b."Centre" AND a."Month" = b."Month"
    WHERE a.attendance_percentage > b.attendance_percentage
)

SELECT
    "Centre",
    AVG("Drop in Percentage Points") AS "Average Drop in Percentage Points"
FROM monthly_drops
GROUP BY "Centre"
ORDER BY "Average Drop in Percentage Points" DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
